I therefore choose no release on the current evidence. The draft retains the 9-unit package and records the clinic design and its prerequisites, but does not authorize the clinic exercises or operational rollout. Audit and preparation can proceed; improved exception handling this week remains unobserved.

The draft separates our proposed operational checklist from the scientist's assessment advice. It preserves the changed-denominator and missing-annotation limitations, restricts assessor review to two attempts, and makes no certification, retention or workforce-wide transfer claim. The remaining unit is unspent; the fallback drill is excluded. I endorse these exact draft bytes in my own operational capacity only. Your commitment to the audit is recorded as a source, not as endorsement of the draft. The unresolved questions remain attendee availability, supervisor acknowledgement and assessor scheduling; I have no supplied confirmation for them.
